title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to use the OData V4 IN operator in web service queries
summary: The OData V4 IN operator simplifies web service queries in Business Central 2024 wave 1 by allowing developers to filter multiple values with a single operator instead of chaining OR conditions. The feature requires schema version 2.1 to work properly.
key_points: OData IN operator lets developers replace multiple OR conditions with a single IN filter expression
Feature was introduced in Business Central 2024 wave 1
The schemaversion parameter must be set to 2.1 for the IN operator to function
Simplifies integration development by reducing query complexity

quotes.text: With this release, the developer can use the OData IN operator and write $filter=CustomerNo IN ('10000','20000','30000').
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the simplified syntax the IN operator provides compared to OR chains
Critical requirement that explains why the IN operator fails without the proper schema version parameter
